name: oah-mondego
description: River contamination to clinical alerts across nine real European rivers (Mondego, Douro, Tagus, Danube, Rhine, Elbe, Oder, Meuse, Sava; 41 stations, 15 EU member states): statistical early-warning detection (EWMA control chart), a trained explainable ML classifier for citizen-submitted water observations, downstream propagation forecasting, FHIR R4 RiskAssessment predictions and an Express CDS Hooks (v3.0 ballot) service.
